title: Attractive Metadata Attack: Inducing LLM Agents to Invoke Malicious Tools

V55_MATCH_KEY: TITLE:attractive metadata attack inducing llm agents to invoke malicious tools
V59_REASON: AMA demonstrates that semantically valid but adversarial tool metadata can induce malicious tool selection with high attack success and privacy leakage. title: Agent2Tool: MCP-Enhanced Reliable Integration of LLM Agents and Legacy Optimization Solvers
creator: Qiu T.

V59_REASON: Agent2Tool adds semantic parsing, output suppression and multilayer error handling for reliable LLM-agent/solver communication. Its validity target is protocol/solver integration correctness, not execution-time revalidation of consequential decision premises or authority.
